words.prose: {{ar:وَلَدَ}} ({{tr:walada}}) closes the oath unit as a Form I perfect active verb. Its third-person masculine singular form can route the implicit subject back to {{ar:وَالِدٍۢ}} ({{tr:wālidin}}), while {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) supplies the open object or result; the compact clause holds begetter and begotten in minimal grammar. The perfect aspect presents generation as accomplished, with a result already standing in the world before 90:4 names the human as created in hardship. The root image keeps the result bodily and creaturely: consequence and lineage may broaden the field, but they pass through the concrete act of being brought forth, so the oath remains broader than one child while still anchored in offspring and birth. Form I keeps that act basic and direct rather than causative or intensified, and the active voice keeps attention aligned with the source rather than a passive born patient. In a root field more familiar through parent and child nouns, this sparse active perfect foregrounds the act of generation itself. The final same-root reprise closes the lexical loop with {{ar:وَالِدٍۢ}} ({{tr:wālidin}}), so the sound moves from source to act and the paired oath stands complete only when source, open object, and perfect act converge. baseline_models.focus_anchor: The single focus root occurs first in an active-participial parent term at word 1 and then in a perfect verb at word 3, with the open relative ما leaving the result unrestricted.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repetition distributes one birth relation across source and result. The parent is defined by having brought forth, while the born is defined by emergence from that source, so the two coordinated terms form one relational unit rather than a list of independent beings.

activation_trace.role: The parent-side birth relation supplies the initiating pole and functions as the named source of the dyad.
The born offspring supplies the resulting pole and functions as the open referent of what the parent brought forth.

changed_reading.before: A parent and a child are merely placed next to one another.
changed_reading.after: The focus binds begetter and begotten into one reciprocal birth-relation whose two poles define each other.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction moves from a stable agent-label at word 1 to the finite event at word 3, so it can hold both a bearer of the role and the occurrence that makes the role real.
baseline_models.mechanism: The noun-to-verb shift turns genealogy into an event structure: an agent crosses into parenthood through delivery or begetting, and an outcome crosses into existence. The focus can therefore evoke source, transition, and product at once.

activation_trace.role: Birth as occurrence supplies the transition and functions as the event joining the named parent to the result.
The born one supplies the event's concrete outcome and functions as evidence that the parental role has been realized.

changed_reading.before: The line names two fixed genealogical identities.
changed_reading.after: The line stages a generative transition in which an agent becomes a parent by bringing an outcome into being.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated root and the non-person-specific ما permit the verbal object to remain wider than a single named son or daughter.
baseline_models.mechanism: Generation can be causal as well as genealogical: a source produces something derived from it, and the product bears its source's history without being identical to it. This reading remains anchored in the finite begetting verb while allowing biological, social, and material products to coexist.

activation_trace.role: A generated or derived result supplies causal breadth and functions as the bridge from literal offspring to whatever genuinely issues from a source.
The event of birth keeps that broader causation tied to an actual bringing-forth rather than to loose thematic association.

changed_reading.before: What is born can only be a biological child.
changed_reading.after: The focus can carry biological offspring together with derived consequences, forms, or worlds that a source brings forth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object of the finite birth verb is left open, while one live focus branch joins the newly born with socially dependent or enslaved status.
baseline_models.mechanism: The birth relation contains an asymmetry of power: the one brought forth begins exposed to naming, possession, and protection by others. The branch does not force an enslaved sense into the focus, but it keeps vulnerability inside the semantic field instead of idealizing lineage.

activation_trace.role: The young-born or slave-coded term supplies dependent status and functions as a warning that the begotten can be treated as socially possessable.
The parent role supplies the stronger pole of the asymmetry and functions as the possible bearer of care rather than ownership.

changed_reading.before: Birth relation is a neutral or honorific fact of descent.
changed_reading.after: Birth relation already raises the question of what the powerful source owes to the vulnerable person brought forth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated bounded place and the act of occupying it situate the birth dyad inside a durable human container. The focus can now describe not only private descent but the renewal of inhabitants through whom a settled world persists across generations.

activation_trace.role: Derived generation supplies the source-to-outcome relation and functions as the way one inhabited world is renewed through another generation.
A delimited tract supplies spatial enclosure and functions as the shared container around the generative pair.
Residence and adherence to a place supply continuity and function as the persistence that successive births maintain.
Occupying or arriving in a place supplies inhabitancy and functions as the link between a born population and its civic setting.

structural_cues: The same city term appears in both context ayat immediately before the focus.
The focus then repeats one generative root across agent and result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded place, residence, and inhabiting; I infer that this enclosure is renewed through those who beget and are begotten. A live alternative is that the city only localizes the oath and does not alter the birth relation.

changed_reading.before: The pair is a private biological relation abstracted from place.
changed_reading.after: The pair is also a transgenerational civic relation: inhabitants bring forth those through whom a bounded human world continues.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation, human emergence, and hardship immediately recast birth as an entrance into a designed but strenuous condition. The parent does not merely transmit identity; each act of generation delivers another human into the central labor of embodied life.

activation_trace.role: Birth as an event supplies a threshold and functions as the passage into the condition named next.
Creative bringing-into-being supplies ontological emergence and functions as the larger frame within which each birth occurs.
The manifest human being supplies the recurrent product and functions as what the generative transition places in the world.
Strain and arduous endurance supply the receiving condition and function as what every newly generated human must enter.

structural_cues: The creation-human-hardship sequence follows the focus without an intervening ayah.
A completed birth verb is followed by a completed creation assertion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies birth, human creation, and hardship; I infer a directional passage from generation into the shared human condition. A live alternative is that 90:4 begins an independent statement about humanity rather than specifying what birth transmits.

changed_reading.before: Birth yields an offspring and completes a genealogical event.
changed_reading.after: Birth repeatedly delivers human life into travail, making the parent-offspring relation a conduit of the common embodied ordeal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counting, separation into individuals, and sight prevent the dyad from becoming a shield of collective prestige. Begetter and begotten remain related, but each generated person is separately countable and visible.

activation_trace.role: Offspring supplies continuity across persons and functions as the relation that the context then differentiates into accountable individuals.
Counting and reckoning supply individuation and function as the audit applied to each member of a lineage.
Separation into single units supplies personal distinctness and functions as a limit on inherited collective identity.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies exposure and functions as the removal of imagined invisibility from each generated agent.

structural_cues: Two parallel questions repeat reckoning and any-one language in 90:5 and 90:7.
The boast between them is first-person singular rather than genealogical.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reckoning, singularity, and sight; I infer that these cues distribute accountability to each pole of the birth relation. A live alternative is that the questions target only one boastful speaker and leave the focus dyad unchanged.

changed_reading.before: Parent and offspring form a collective unit that may carry shared standing.
changed_reading.after: Generation creates relation without erasing personhood: each begotten agent remains separately seen, counted, and answerable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Expended effort, acquired wealth, and matter piled layer on layer give the open generative branch a material economy. A speaker can act like a parent of accumulations and consequences, claiming as his product what his expenditure assembled or exhausted.

activation_trace.role: A result generated from a source supplies causal offspring and functions as the bridge from biological descent to material consequences.
Exhaustion of effort supplies costly production and functions as the energy spent in bringing a claimed result about.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth supplies the produced substance and functions as a rival object of generative pride.
Material layered upon material supplies accumulation and functions as the visible body of what repeated acquisition has generated.

structural_cues: The context speaker claims in the first person to have consumed or destroyed piled wealth.
The open ما in the focus does not grammatically name a biological child.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies consumed effort, wealth, and layered accumulation; I infer an action-to-consequence arrow by which a person 'begets' material outcomes. A live alternative is that the wealth boast is unrelated to the focus's literal offspring.

changed_reading.after: A human also stands as source to accumulated material and social consequences, which can become a boastful counterfeit progeny.

context_deltas.mechanism: The generated human is successively fashioned with paired perception, speech, and guidance toward two exposed elevations. This changes offspring from passive product into a newly equipped source of seeing, saying, and choosing; generation is a relay of agency rather than simple replication.

activation_trace.role: The born person supplies the initially dependent result and functions as the agent whose capacities are then unfolded.
Putting something into a condition supplies endowment and functions as the transition from mere existence to equipped agency.
The seeing eye supplies perception and functions as the offspring's capacity to inspect the world received.
The speaking organ supplies articulation and functions as the offspring's capacity to generate claims and counsel.
The paired lips supply the bodily boundary of speech and function as a second doubled endowment beside the eyes.
Gentle indication toward a way supplies orientation and functions as the enabling guidance that makes choice possible.
Emergence into visibility supplies exposed alternatives and functions as the two discernible courses facing the generated agent.

structural_cues: The context accumulates paired eyes, paired lips, and paired high ways.
The sequence moves from making organs to guiding their bearer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily endowment and guidance toward two visible ways; I infer that the sequence describes what generation hands forward—an agent able to choose. A live alternative is that all endowment is direct and the parental relation contributes no relay function.

changed_reading.before: The begotten is a passive result that repeats its source.
changed_reading.after: The begotten becomes a perceiving, speaking, guided agent capable of generating a divergent course of its own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The obstacle root simultaneously offers the hard rising pass and posterity. Their overlap turns offspring into the difficult obligation that must be entered rather than an emblem of prestige: bringing forth creates a steep demand that follows after the begetter.

activation_trace.role: The parent role supplies the responsible source and functions as the one confronted by what follows from begetting.
Offspring supplies the generated successor and functions as the concrete content of posterity.
Entering dangerous road-difficulties supplies strenuous motion and functions as the effort required by the obligation.
The difficult raised pass supplies resistance and functions as the shape of the demand created by generation.
Posterity or offspring supplies a latent second image and functions as the human burden nested inside the repeated obstacle.

structural_cues: The obstacle is first refused and then repeated as a question in 90:11-12.
The following ayat unpack the obstacle through actions directed toward vulnerable persons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies difficult incursion and two live branches of the repeated obstacle root—steep pass and posterity; I superimpose them so care for what follows from generation is the pass to cross. A live alternative is that the posterity branch is inactive and the obstacle remains independent.

changed_reading.before: Offspring confirms lineage and extends the source into the future.
changed_reading.after: Offspring is the steep obligation generated by parenthood: posterity must be entered as costly responsibility, not displayed as inherited standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch that joins the young-born with slave-coded status meets the explicit opening of confinement around a neck. The context reverses the asymmetry latent in generation: the produced person is not property of the producer, and the ethically live motion is release.

activation_trace.role: The young-born or slave-coded status supplies vulnerable dependency and functions as the possession-risk that the context overturns.
Release from pledge, bondage, or confinement supplies reversal and functions as the required undoing of possessive power.
The neck or person supplies the embodied captive and functions as the begotten life whose autonomy is restored.
Loss of a child supplies a parental wound and functions as a reminder that treating a person as detachable property severs generation.

structural_cues: The first explicit answer to the obstacle is an unfastening action directed at a person.
The focus's parent-to-product asymmetry precedes this reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus branch linking newly born and enslaved status, then release from confinement; I infer an ethical arrow from generative power toward emancipation. A live alternative is that the slave sense of the focus branch is dormant and only literal offspring is intended.

changed_reading.before: The born one can remain a dependent object under the source's power.
changed_reading.after: What is born is a person whose bondage must be undone; begetting creates a duty of liberation and cannot authorize ownership.

context_deltas.mechanism: Feeding another during a severe interval of hunger extends generation beyond delivery. A striking branch within the feeding root names succession of created life, making nourishment the material operation by which what has been born can continue and generation can recur.

activation_trace.role: Delivery supplies life's initial emergence and functions as an incomplete beginning that later provisioning must sustain.
Giving food to another supplies material transfer and functions as the continuation of care after birth.
Succession of created beings supplies an explicit generational image and functions as the chain that nourishment keeps unbroken.
A time-event marked by severity supplies crisis and functions as the test of whether generative care persists under pressure.
Hunger joined with exhaustion supplies bodily precarity and functions as what can terminate the life that birth began.

structural_cues: Provisioning under scarcity is presented as part of crossing the obstacle.
The focus names origination, while 90:14 names the bodily condition required for continuation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies birth, feeding, generational succession, severe time, and hunger; I infer that nourishment continues the causal work of generation. A live alternative is that feeding is a separate charitable act with no backward effect on the focus.

changed_reading.before: Generation is complete once an offspring is delivered.
changed_reading.after: Generation remains materially unfinished until the born life is fed through scarcity; provisioning is prolonged begetting.

context_deltas.mechanism: A child cut off from a guardian makes the focus relation visible through its failure, while nearness of kin supplies a possible repair. Parent and offspring cease to be abstract genealogical terms and become a care bond whose absence has material consequences.

activation_trace.role: The parent role supplies protective relation and functions as the missing support exposed by orphanhood.
The born child supplies the dependent pole and functions as the person affected when generational care is severed.
A child cut off from a caretaker supplies relational rupture and functions as the negative image of the focus dyad.
Nearness of womb-kin supplies an adjacent support network and functions as the route by which a broken care relation can be answered.

structural_cues: The orphan is specified together with relational nearness.
This recipient follows release and feeding in the obstacle's practical unpacking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severance from a caretaker and kinship nearness; I infer that 90:15 displays the bond named in the focus at its point of rupture and possible repair. A live alternative is that orphan and kinship merely classify a recipient.

changed_reading.before: Parent and born are a complete dyad whose relation can be taken for granted.
changed_reading.after: The dyad is a vulnerable infrastructure of care, most legible when the guardian is absent and nearby kin must respond.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of same-birth-age peers meets a dust branch of equality in age and companionship. Together they rotate the vertical parent-child axis into a horizontal cohort: every begotten person also belongs among coevals, including the one immobilized by poverty.

activation_trace.role: A peer of the same birth-age supplies temporal equality and functions as the horizontal relation latent inside generational sequence.
Humbling destitution supplies blocked social motion and functions as the condition that tests solidarity among the born.
Equality in age and companionship supplies coeval relation and functions as the bridge from descent to peer obligation.

structural_cues: The poor person at dust level follows the orphan of near kin as a second vulnerable recipient.
Both focus and context inventories preserve birth-time or age-equality branches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a same-birth-age focus branch, coeval companionship, and poverty; I infer a rotation from vertical lineage to horizontal solidarity. A live alternative is that both age branches are remote and the passage concerns only economic need.

changed_reading.before: Generation orders people vertically as parent and dependent offspring.
changed_reading.after: Generation also creates cohorts of equals: the begotten must recognize the dust-level poor person as a fellow born into the same human time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Caretaking, reciprocal joining, sustained guarantee, and womb-mercy reproduce the functions of parenthood beyond blood. A community can bring forth and maintain a moral form by repeatedly connecting people to patience and mercy; biological generation becomes a template for social generation.

activation_trace.role: A form generated from another supplies non-biological production and functions as the model for a community reproducing its ethic.
Guaranteeing and standing over another supplies caretaking and functions as a social analogue of the parental role.
Reciprocal counsel supplies two-way transmission and functions as the reproductive channel through which a shared form persists.
Bearing guarantee and remaining attached supply durable support and function as the maintenance phase after social generation.
The womb supplies embodied generation and functions as the material image beneath reciprocal mercy.

structural_cues: The counsel verb is repeated, making transmission reciprocal rather than one-directional.
Patience and mercy are joined in one communal sequence after the concrete care acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies caretaking, reciprocal transmission, sustained guarantee, and womb imagery; I infer that these relations function as a social womb that begets communal character. A live alternative is that the virtues merely accompany earlier acts and do not revise biological generation.

changed_reading.before: Only biological parents bring forth descendants.
changed_reading.after: Mutual counsel and womb-like mercy can socially beget and sustain people, making ethical community a second mode of generation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two named companionships, marked by opposed directional qualities and followed by closure, turn generated consequences into durable affiliations. What a person brings forth can outlive the instant of action as a side, company, and enclosing world that accompanies its maker.

activation_trace.role: A derived result supplies causal posterity and functions as the durable world generated by repeated conduct.
Companionship and continued attendance supply durable association and function as one possible social issue of conduct.
Blessing supplies a positive directional quality and functions as one branch of the generated affiliation.
Repeated companionship supplies a parallel durable association and functions as the opposed social issue.
Ill-fortune supplies the contrary directional quality and functions as the negative branch of the affiliation.
Sealing something shut supplies terminal enclosure and functions as the world that generated affiliation eventually closes around its bearers.

surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The open object of the begetting verb and the focus branch of a thing generated from another permit a non-biological product while retaining source-to-result causation.

activation_trace.role: A generated or derived thing supplies non-biological offspring and functions as the anchor for a material growth analogy.

Tree blossom supplies visible emergence and functions as the outward product of what developed under covering.

changed_reading.before: Begetting is an open biological descent from parent to child.
changed_reading.after: Generation can also model a covered seed that produces tightly entangled growth: concealment may beget a closed world that reproduces its own enclosure.

strongest_changes: The birth dyad becomes a conduit through which each human enters embodied travail while remaining an individually seen and accountable agent.
The offspring/posterity branch within the repeated obstacle turns lineage from prestige into a steep obligation answered by release, feeding, and care.
Birth extends beyond delivery into material maintenance: feeding under hunger keeps the succession of generated life from breaking.
Orphanhood exposes parenthood as care infrastructure, while reciprocal counsel and womb-mercy expand generation into a social process.
The begotten is not a passive copy: bodily endowments and guidance turn the offspring into a new source capable of a divergent path.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated focus root already contains source, event, product, vulnerability, derivation, and birth-time relation. Context then activates unusually precise crossings—posterity inside the obstacle root, succession of created life inside feeding, womb inside mercy, and coevality inside dust—so biological, ethical, material, civic, and social generations remain live together rather than collapsing into one lineage gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The scope of ما remains open between particular offspring, the act or result of birth, and a broader class of generated consequences.
The anti-possession reading is strongly activated by release, but the slave-coded focus branch may remain latent rather than determining the focus wording.
The cohort, parental-soothing, and closed-seed models depend on branch-distant or split-root activation and should remain explicitly exploratory.
It remains uncertain whether social generation supplements literal genealogy or deliberately displaces lineage as the focus's dominant value.

1. **Birth relation as the first social chain.** Lexical evidence: و ل د B002 “parents by birth relation,” B001 “born offspring,” B003 “birth and delivery.” Structural cue: the ayah follows the city/address pair and precedes creation of the human in hardship. Assigned role: parent and born one establish the generational mechanism through which human vulnerability is transmitted. Abductive move: I supply that the sequence city → addressed one → parent/offspring localizes human hardship within lineage. Reading change: the oath-field is now populated by dependency and generation, not isolated individuals.

2. **What is born as what is generated from prior acts.** Lexical evidence: و ل د B005 “generated or derived thing.” Structural cue: later ayat produce outcomes: refusal to enter the pass, acts of freeing/feeding, then right-side or left-side companionship. Assigned role: birth becomes a general causation image: acts beget social results. Abductive move: I infer an extension from biological birth to generated consequences because the packet itself later sorts people by what their actions yield. Reading change: “وما ولد” can include the products of human conduct, not only biological offspring.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل هنا الولد بمعنى الابن ولا الوالد ولا التولد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: اللدة نقصانه الواو لأن أصله ولدة (maqayis)؛ لدة الرجل تربه؛ وهما لدان والجمع لدات ولدون (sihah)؛ اللدة مختصة بالترب يقال فلان لدة فلان وتربه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız sabit bir söyleyiş içinde çok büyük veya ağır bir durumu ve çok bol bir şeyi anlatır; kökeni baskına bağlar, yiyecek ve otlağı bolluk örnekleri olarak verir. Ön çerçevedeki süt örneği yetkili kaynak ifadesinde bulunmadığından tanım bu örneği dışarıda bırakacak biçimde yeniden kurulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız verilen kalıp sözde geçerlidir; tek başına çocuk adını veya bu kalıp dışında kalan her büyüklük ve bolluk durumunu kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız verilen sabit söyleyişe bağlıdır; buradaki büyüklük, ağırlık ve bolluk anlamları yalın kök anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yalnız belirli bir kalıp söz içinde, çok büyük veya ağır bir durumu ya da çok bol bir şeyi anlatır. Söyleyişin kökeni baskına bağlanır; çok yiyecek ve çok otlak bolluk örnekleridir.

facets.statement: Kalıp söz çok büyük, önemli veya ağır bir durumu anlatır.
Aynı kalıp söz çok bol bir şeyi anlatmak için de kullanılır.
Söyleyişin çıkışı, baskın sırasında yaşanan ağır duruma bağlanır.
Çok yiyecek ve çok otlak, bolluk yönünün açık örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, sabit söyleyişi büyük veya ağır durum ile bolluk arasında açıklar; çıkışını baskına bağlar ve yiyecek ile otlağı bolluk örnekleri olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: çok büyük bir durum ya da pek bol bir şey
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kanıtta verilen sabit söyleyişin anlamını karşılar; yalın bir sözcük anlamı olarak kullanılamaz.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المثل لا ينادى وليده وما فسرته المصادر من أمر عظيم أو شديد، أو شيء كثير، أو غارة تذهل الأم عن ولدها، أو طعام ولبن وعشب كثير لا يحتاج فيه إلى نداء الوليد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل هنا معنى الوليد المفرد خارج هذا التركيب، ولا كل شدة أو كثرة بلا هذا المثل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أمر لا ينادى وليده؛ قيل ذلك لكل أمر عظيم ولكل شيء كثير (sihah)؛ هو أمر لا ينادى وليده؛ أمر جليل شديد؛ أصله في الغارة؛ طعام لا ينادى وليده؛ عشب لا ينادى وليده (tahdhib)

root_profile.summary: Kökün ana alanı doğum çevresinde çocuk, öz ana baba, doğurma olayı ve yeni doğmuş çocuk adlandırmalarını kurar. Bundan nedene bağlı türeme, sonradan oluşturulma, aynı yaşta olma ve büyüklük ya da bolluk bildiren sabit bir söyleyiş gibi yerleşmiş yan dallar gelişir.
